judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: Thunder inside the marsh: Going Along.
So the noble one, as dusk comes on,
goes in to feast and rest.
lines: If he goes out of the gate, his dealings have merit.
He is bound to the small boy,
and so loses the grown man.
He is bound to the grown man,
and so loses the small boy.
Going along, he gets what he seeks.
It is good to stay and hold firm.
Going along, he makes a catch.
But if his trust on the road is brought to light —
He puts his trust in what is fine.
He is held fast and bound fast,
The king makes his offering at the western mountain.

notes.name_en: 隨 is following along after; 'Going Along', not Wilhelm's 'Following'.
notes.L6: 亨 here 享, offering/sacrifice at 西山 the western mountain.
